title: Knowledge
lead: Long-lived libraries that any conversation can call into. Upload documents once, ask anywhere.
emptyBody: A library keeps your documents available to conversations. Create one to get started.

dialog.title: New knowledge library
dialog.body: Add documents once and use this library from any conversation.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameExists: A knowledge base with this name already exists.
dialog.unavailable: Knowledge bases are temporarily unavailable. Contact the administrator or try again later.

detail.noDocsBody: Upload PDF, Office, Markdown, text, or spreadsheet files and Aivory indexes them for retrieval.
detail.noMatchesBody: Try another file name or uploader.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this library and all its documents?
detail.failedReason: Indexing failed. You can retry after fixing the related configuration.
detail.renameFileDescription: Change the name shown in this knowledge base.
detail.loadFailedTitle: Could not load this knowledge base

groupPermissionRequired: Your user group does not have knowledge-base access.
accessRevokedBody: This knowledge base was deleted or is no longer shared with you.
workspaceCreatePermissionRequired: You do not have permission to create knowledge bases in this workspace.
fileUploadPermissionRequired: Your user group does not have permission to upload files.
sharingPermissionRequired: Your user group does not have permission to share knowledge bases.
permissionChanged: Your access changed. The knowledge base has been refreshed.
limitReached: You've reached your plan's knowledge-base limit.

share.title: Share knowledge base
share.description: Give people read-only access or allow them to upload and manage their own files.

workspaceMembers.title: Knowledge-base member permissions
workspaceMembers.description: These settings apply only to this knowledge base. Workspace member permissions remain the upper limit.

deleteBody: This permanently deletes “{{name}}” and all its documents and index data. Conversations that reference it will be unlinked. This cannot be undone.
